OMGS3.kicad_sym, OMGS3.kicad_mod and OMGS3_Carrier_R1.kicad_pcb (source of the USB-C 16P
footprint) are copied unchanged from https://github.com/UnexpectedMaker/esp32s3
(kicad/symbols, kicad/footprints, kicad/OMGS3 Carrier), fetched
2026-10-22. The generators read them from here. Their license (kicad/LICENSE in that repo) is copied here as LICENSE.
